title.zh: 把运单和账单合到一起

description.zh: 把几份运单和账单自动对到一起，直接得到对账表
description.en: Build one clear reconciliation sheet by shipment number

template.zh: 这些是 <运单、报价、客户账单、承运商账单和回单表>。请按 <运单号或其他对应方法> 合成一张对账表，套用 <你要使用的对账模板>，并标出对不上、重复或缺少信息的记录。
template.en: Match <Shipment, quote, customer bill, carrier bill, and receipt sheets> using <Shipment number or another matching method>, follow <My template>, and flag unmatched, duplicate, or missing records.

zh: 运单、报价、客户账单、承运商账单和回单表
运单号或其他对应方法
en: Shipment, quote, customer bill, carrier bill, and receipt sheets
Shipment number or another matching method

description.zh: 把金额差额一次找出来，并算清一共差多少钱
description.en: Find undercharges, overpayments, duplicates, and unsupported fees

template.zh: 请把 <报价、合同和账单> 放在一起对账，按照 <公司的收费和付款规则> 找出少收、多付、重复收费、漏收或没有凭证的费用，并按 <需要重点查看的客户、线路或金额范围> 算清一共差多少钱。
template.en: Compare <Quotes, contracts, and bills>, follow <Company charging and payment rules>, find undercharges, overpayments, duplicates, missed charges, or unsupported fees, and use <Amount range or focus> to calculate the difference.

zh: 公司的收费和付款规则
需要重点查看的客户、线路或金额范围

title.en: Check Whether Each Job Can Be Settled

description.zh: 逐票判断能不能结账，并列清还缺什么、该找谁补
description.en: Find missing receipts, cost evidence, and approvals

template.zh: 请按 <公司的结算要求> 检查 <每票货的回单、费用凭证和审批资料>，按照 <你习惯的分组方式> 告诉我哪些能结账、哪些暂时不能、分别缺什么，以及该找谁补。
template.en: Using <Company settlement requirements>, check <Receipts, cost evidence, and approvals for each shipment>, follow <My grouping method>, and show what can be settled, what cannot, what is missing, and who should provide it.

zh: 每票货的回单、费用凭证和审批资料
en: Receipts, cost evidence, and approvals for each shipment

title.zh: 检查开票资料并写申请
title.en: Check Invoice Details and Draft the Request

description.zh: 核对公司名称、税号、金额和对应运单
description.en: Check company name, tax ID, amount, and related shipments

template.zh: 请检查 <客户开票资料> 和 <已经确认的运单及金额>，按照 <公司的开票申请模板> 核对公司名称、税号、税率、金额和对应运单，并写好开票申请。
template.en: Check <Customer invoice details> against <Confirmed shipments and amounts>, follow <Company invoice request template>, verify company name, tax ID, tax rate, amount, and related shipments, and draft the request.

zh: 已经确认的运单及金额
